parq_block.title: PAR-Q+ pre-screening
parq_block.hint: Standard pre-participation screening. Any 'Yes' suggests physician clearance.

questions.q1: Has a doctor ever said you have a heart condition or that you should only do physical activity recommended by a doctor?
questions.q2: Do you feel pain in your chest when you do physical activity?
questions.q3: In the past month, have you had chest pain when you were not doing physical activity?
questions.q4: Do you lose your balance because of dizziness or do you ever lose consciousness?
questions.q5: Do you have a bone or joint problem that could be made worse by a change in your physical activity?
questions.q6: Is your doctor currently prescribing drugs for blood pressure or a heart condition?
questions.q7: Do you know of any other reason why you should not do physical activity?

rationale.cardio: Cardiovascular flag. Medical clearance recommended before moderate-vigorous intensity. Protocol can still draft a low-intensity plan, flagged for physician review.
rationale.balance: Balance flag. Plan will avoid free-weight overhead movements and unsupported standing exercises until cleared by a physician.
rationale.msk: Musculoskeletal flag. Plan will exclude high-impact patterns and aggressive progressive loading. Mobility-first protocol available.
rationale.manual: Manual flag. Note specifics in client medical conditions. PDF export will include a physician-review disclaimer.

parq_block.flag_summary_note: Plan generation will default to low-intensity. Override available.

risk_block.title: Risk stratification
risk_block.hint: ACSM-style coronary risk factor count → low / moderate / high.
risk_block.family_cvd: Family history of CVD (1st-degree, <55 M / <65 F)
risk_block.smoking_hint: Current smokers carry highest CVD risk.
risk_block.bmi_hint: Underweight <18.5 · Normal 18.5–24.9 · Overweight 25–29.9 · Obese ≥30. Use 'Muscular' when BMI ≥25 but body-fat % is within athletic range (♂ ≤17%, ♀ ≤24%) — BMI overestimates adiposity in resistance-trained individuals.

anthro_block.title: Anthropometry
anthro_block.hint: Body composition baseline. Waist-to-hip ratio is computed automatically.
anthro_block.waist_hint: Measure at narrowest point above the hip bone, exhale.
anthro_block.hip_hint: Measure at the widest part of the buttocks.
anthro_block.bf_pct_hint: Optional. Use the same method over time for trend.
anthro_block.measure_height_instructions: De pie, descalzo, talones juntos, mirando al frente. Inspira.
anthro_block.measure_waist_instructions: En el punto más estrecho sobre la cadera, de pie, exhalando.
anthro_block.measure_hip_instructions: En el punto más ancho de la cadera, pies juntos.
anthro_block.measure_chest_instructions: A la altura de los pezones, de pie, brazos relajados.
anthro_block.measure_arm_instructions: Punto medio del bíceps, brazo relajado al costado.
anthro_block.measure_thigh_instructions: Punto medio entre cadera y rodilla, de pie, peso equilibrado.
anthro_block.measure_calf_instructions: Punto más ancho de la pantorrilla, de pie, peso equilibrado.

meds_block.title: Medication & supplements
meds_block.hint: Beta-blockers blunt HR; statins risk myalgia; anticoagulants require contact-sport caution.

goal_block.title: Objetivo principal (SMART)
goal_block.hint: Compromiso de trabajo medible durante una ventana de tiempo.
goal_block.specific_placeholder: p.ej. fuerza de sentadilla, técnica y progreso
goal_block.specific_hint: Lo que vamos a trabajar específicamente.
goal_block.measurable_placeholder: p.ej. 1RM/5RM en sentadilla; medir cada 4 semanas
goal_block.measurable_hint: Métrica + frecuencia. Meta exploratoria, ajustada por datos reales.
goal_block.deadline_hint: Cuándo reevaluamos el progreso. No es punto de llegada.

goals.empty: Elige una categoría para ver focos de trabajo comunes
goals.confirm_overwrite: Has personalizado los campos. ¿Reemplazar con la plantilla?

str_squat_15bw_5.specific: Trabajar fuerza de sentadilla durante 16 semanas, medir progreso
str_squat_15bw_5.measurable: Seguir 1RM/5RM en sentadilla; meta exploratoria: 1,5×PC × 5 reps

str_bench_bw_5.specific: Trabajar fuerza de empuje horizontal durante 16 semanas
str_bench_bw_5.measurable: Seguir 1RM/5RM en banca; meta exploratoria: 1×PC × 5 reps

str_dl_2bw_3.specific: Trabajar fuerza de tracción y cadena posterior durante 20 semanas
str_dl_2bw_3.measurable: Seguir 1RM/3RM en peso muerto; meta exploratoria: 2×PC × 3 reps

hyp_arm_3cm.specific: Trabajar hipertrofia de brazo durante 12 semanas, medir progreso
hyp_arm_3cm.measurable: Medir perímetro de brazo cada 4 semanas; observar tendencia

hyp_thigh_4cm.specific: Trabajar hipertrofia de muslo durante 12 semanas, medir progreso
hyp_thigh_4cm.measurable: Medir perímetro de muslo cada 4 semanas; observar tendencia

comp_fatloss_5.specific: Reducir grasa durante 16 semanas, manteniendo masa magra
comp_fatloss_5.measurable: Seguir composición (DEXA/BIA) cada 4-6 semanas; ajustar por trayectoria

comp_recomp.specific: Recomposición corporal durante 20 semanas (perder grasa, ganar masa magra)
comp_recomp.measurable: Seguir composición y fuerza en paralelo; ajustar según respuesta

end_5k_25.specific: Trabajar resistencia de carrera 5 km durante 10 semanas
end_5k_25.measurable: Seguir tiempo en 5 km cada 3-4 semanas; meta exploratoria: ≤ 25:00

end_cooper_2400.measurable: Reaplicar Cooper 12 min cada 4 semanas; meta exploratoria: ≥ 2400 m

mob_toes_painfree.specific: Trabajar movilidad lumbar e isquiotibial durante 6 semanas
mob_toes_painfree.measurable: Sit-and-reach y percepción de dolor; medir cada 2 semanas

mob_overhead_full.specific: Trabajar movilidad torácica y de hombros durante 8 semanas
mob_overhead_full.measurable: Test overhead contra pared; medir cada 2 semanas

fn_carry_30s.specific: Trabajar fuerza funcional de transporte (carry) durante 12 semanas
fn_carry_30s.measurable: Tiempo en farmer's carry con carga progresiva; reevaluar cada 4 semanas

fn_get_up_floor.specific: Trabajar movilidad integrada suelo-pie durante 8 semanas
fn_get_up_floor.measurable: Evaluar Turkish get-up sin manos cada 2 semanas; observar limpieza del patrón

readiness_block.title: Readiness to change (Prochaska)
readiness_block.hint: Stage of behavioral change — calibrates coaching approach.

training_block.title: Training setup
training_block.hint: Frequency, location, available equipment, and constraints.

lifestyle_block.title: Lifestyle & recovery
lifestyle_block.hint: Daily activity, recovery markers, and sleep/stress modulators.
lifestyle_block.sleep_hint: Subjective average sleep quality this past month.
lifestyle_block.hours_seated_hint: Total sitting time including work + commute.

mobility_block.title: Mobility — anatomical (1–5)
mobility_block.hint: Score each region: 1 = severely restricted, 5 = full pain-free range.
mobility_block.shoulder_hint: De pie, levanta ambos brazos lateralmente hasta tocar las orejas. Sin dolor y sin rotar el tronco = 5.
mobility_block.hip_hint: Tumbado boca arriba, lleva la rodilla al pecho. El muslo toca el tronco sin levantar la cadera opuesta = 5.
mobility_block.ankle_hint: De pie a ~10 cm de la pared, dobla la rodilla hasta tocar la pared sin levantar el talón = 5.
mobility_block.thoracic_hint: Sentado, manos detrás de la cabeza, rota el tronco a cada lado. ~45° simétrico sin compensación lumbar = 5.
mobility_block.wrist_hint: Palma arriba, con la otra mano tira de los dedos hacia abajo. 90° de flexión sin dolor = 5.
mobility_block.knee_hint: Sentado, extiende totalmente la rodilla. El talón se levanta sin dolor y sin tirar detrás de la rodilla = 5.

screen_block.title: Movement screen
screen_block.hint: Functional pattern quality. 1 = restricted → 5 = controlled full range.

history_block.title: Training history
history_block.hint: Prior exposure shapes starting loads and progression rates.

performance_block.title: Cardiovascular health
performance_block.rockport_protocol: Camine 1 milla (1.6 km) lo más rápido posible sin correr. Use cronómetro. Al llegar, mida el pulso 15s × 4. Introduzca los valores abajo.
performance_block.rockport_missing_prereq: Faltan peso, edad o sexo en el perfil — complete Antropometría primero.
